summary: End-to-end verification of the WhatsApp expansion features (Inbox, Intake opt-in, Admin command shortcuts). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_whatsapp_features.py (18 tests) — all 18 PASS. Playwright verified: (1) Login page heading is 'IGC Trust Portal' with 'Sign in to your IGC Trust Portal account.' subheader; (2) admin nav shows 'WhatsApp' link (data-testid nav-admin-whatsapp-inbox); (3) /admin/whatsapp-inbox renders with threads (seeded via webhook), Attach modal opens with searchable case list, Archive removes thread after confirm; (4) intake wizard Grantor step shows the green-bordered whatsapp-opt-in-card with grantor phone once a grantor is added, checkbox POSTs /trust-cases/{id}/whatsapp-opt-in and success toast fires ('Opted in (welcome logged; delivery pending sandbox)') — verified backend stored whatsapp_opt_in=true, whatsapp_welcomed_at set, and exactly 1 welcome entry appears in whatsapp_thread with system='welcome'; unchecking flips to false with 'WhatsApp updates paused' toast; (5) AdminCaseDetail still renders WhatsAppPanel with 'Live' badge and existing send/thread endpoints work. Admin commands: /whoami, /cases, /case <sid> info/status/note all execute correctly — status flips confirmed via GET /admin/trust-cases/{id}, note appended to admin_notes with author='WhatsApp Admin'. Invalid short id and bogus status properly rejected with no side-effects. Idempotency of welcome verified (2nd opt_in:true call does NOT create 2nd welcome). Twilio sandbox returning sent:false is expected — we assert DB side-effects, not delivery.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4,840 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting per-domain modules (whatsapp routes, trust-cases routes, admin routes, auth routes) into separate FastAPI routers included on api_router. Everything is still working; this is a maintainability nit.

whatsapp_commands.handle_admin_command catches every command exception with a generic 'Command failed' reply — good UX, but the exception is swallowed by the outer try/except in twilio_whatsapp_inbound as well, causing double-logging. Consider passing structured errors up.

Idempotency of welcome relies on whatsapp_welcomed_at flag on the case doc — correct. However once flipped to false and back to true the flag is still set, so subsequent re-opt-ins never re-fire the welcome. That's acceptable per spec ('one-time welcome') but worth documenting for the client team.

/admin/whatsapp/inbox/archive uses a raw dict body instead of a Pydantic model (unlike attach which uses InboxAttachReq). Minor consistency nit — a WhatsAppInboxArchiveReq model would give automatic validation for from_number.

GrantorStep opt-in card falls back to trust_case.client_phone only if grantors[0].phone is missing. If a grantor is added WITHOUT a phone, the card will still render (grantors.length > 0) and the toggle error 'Add a grantor with a phone number first' fires only after click. Consider hiding the card until a phone is available.
